assessment_type: Narrow source-only coverage candidate assessment; not a new final independent saturation verdict
candidate: Ordinary gain origin for Solari, spice and water

source_evidence.heading: Resources: Solari, Spice, Water
source_evidence.text: Resources: Solari, Spice, Water. When you gain a resource or pay one as a cost, it’s taken from or returned to the bank. (For Solari and spice, gain or pay the amount shown.)
The same resource-icon instruction explicitly supplies the bank as the origin of gained resources.

source_interpretation: The source explicitly assigns the bank as the origin for ordinary resource gains. It is not an inference from component ownership, bank exhaustion or payment destinations. Taking tokens from an opponent would incorrectly reduce that opponent’s holdings, so the distinction changes game state.

complete_bank_comparison.method: Compared the candidate against all actual question wording in the complete authorized benchmark bank previously read. Rechecked resource/gain/bank/origin-related wording and the closest keys. Incidental key background received no direct-question coverage credit.

closest_existing_questions.judgment: Does not request gain origin. Payment direction and gain origin are distinct explicit clauses of the same resource rule.

complete_bank_comparison.other_questions: No remaining actual question requests the default physical origin of gained Solari, spice or water.

novelty_rationale: Accept exactly one grouped question for the single general resource-gain origin rule. Do not create separate Solari, spice and water variants. This is not a changed amount/name within a tested branch: an ordinary gain from the bank leaves opponents’ holdings intact, whereas taking from another player changes two players’ holdings. The source explicitly defines that legal origin. Q22’s correct incidental key clause cannot substitute for an actual requested question part.

narrow_question_and_key.question: When an ordinary effect tells you to gain Solari, spice or water, where do the gained resource tokens come from? May you take them from another player’s supply instead?
narrow_question_and_key.expected_answer: Take ordinary resource gains from the common bank. Do not take them from another player’s supply.

rejected_extensions: Separate per-resource questions would be duplicates.
Do not add a stealing, trading or transfer exception absent an explicit applicable source. The candidate concerns ordinary gains only.
Do not repeat payment destination or bank exhaustion, already requested by Q22.
independence_statement: Used only the authorized final bank/key and source texts. Did not inspect summaries, reader answers/grades, prior reports, repair history or Q59 history. The earlier independent report was preserved without reading or modification. This candidate assessment does not replace or restate a final saturation verdict.
